topic: The 10-minute conversation that gets your teen off the couch
caption:
The 10-minute conversation that can change your teen's whole summer.

Ask them: 'What do people always ask you to help with?' Most teens already have a skill worth $15-25/hr.

Write down the answer together. That's their first hustle.
